adjudication_label: batch_1:MD equilibration and time scale validity
canonical_question: Does the 100 ps equilibration time in the NVT ensemble at 300 K guarantee that the system has fully relaxed before the indentation starts?

question_variants.question: Does the 100 ps equilibration time in the NVT ensemble at 300 K guarantee that the system has fully relaxed before the indentation starts?
question_variants.resolution_summary: The text states that the NVT ensemble was used to maintain the system at 300 K for 100 ps. It does not provide any data or statement confirming that this duration guarantees full relaxation of the system before indentation begins.

answers.answer: The text confirms the use of the NVT ensemble for 100 ps at 300 K as the equilibration step, but does not explicitly state that this time is sufficient to guarantee full relaxation.
answers.material: Cu matrix / FeNiCrCoCu high entropy alloy coating
answers.boundary_limitation: No confirmation of full relaxation provided
evidence_spans: In the nanoindentation model, single crystal Cu was used as the matrix material and FeNiCrCoCu high entropy alloy was used as the coating material.
The same lattice types of both materials were set.
The model size of the Cu matrix was 100 Å × 100 Å × 55 Å, and the total number of atoms was 47,111.

source_evidence_spans: The fourth step was to use the NVT ensemble model to maintain 100 ps at 300 K.
